label: A self-originating being has an occurring exercise of its own producing its existence
term: productive-exercise reading of a self-origin edge
definition: OriginHasProductiveSelfExercise F Occurs bearer produces: for every self-origin edge CausesOrigin x x, there exists an exercise a with Occurs a, bearer a = x and produces a x. CausesOrigin, Occurs, bearer and produces keep exactly the meanings fixed in the universal productive-exercise reading (9022c4bf): CausesOrigin is the primitive CAUSE_4 relation of causal responsibility for x coming to be, and produces is production of the being (existence) of the resultant individual in the sense of DEF-NO-EXISTENTIAL-SELF-PRODUCTION (eee784e7), not merely of its coming-to-be. This is the self-edge instance of the universal reading and says nothing about origin edges between distinct beings. For a self-origin edge, the step from 'x is responsible for its own coming to be' to 'an exercise borne by x produces x's being' remains OPEN content of this bridge.
note: Analyst bridge, attribution deferred (#1610). Weak sibling of the universal bridge 9022c4bf, which strengthens it (verified instantiation result); their certified difference is NonSelfOriginHasProductiveExercise, the clause for edges that are not self-edges. Warrant: being entailed by the universal form it has at least that warrant; the actual-exercise requirement (Aristotle Physics II.3) applies to a self-originating x as to any positive efficient originator. The builder case (a cause of a house's becoming, not of its being, ST I q.104 a.1) and Hall-style omission and prevention cases have distinct relata and bear only on the universal form's distinct-relata clause. The broad dependence reading of CAUSE_4 bears on this sibling only through a self-edge such as the Smith whole, which stays OPEN. What it keeps is the self-edge case of the coming-to-be-to-being step, which is where the Smith/Newman whole-universe dispute sits: whether a whole that is said to originate itself through its constituents' reciprocal origination bears an exercise producing its own being. That dispute is OPEN; docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md, Why the bridge is universal and its self-edge sibling.
